The <h2 className='text-lg font-semibold text-gray-200 mb-4'> heading (L83-85) -> an AppText weight='semibold' styled fontSize 18 / lineHeight 24 / marginBottom spacing.md / textPrimary, rendering t('admin.security.eventHistory','Security Event History'). The isLoading ternary (L86-101): true -> <Skeleton lines={8}/> (L87) using the native Skeleton; false -> the inlined native DataTable<SecurityEvent> with columns={eventColumns}, data={history}, keyExtractor={row=>row.id} (L93), emptyMessage t('admin.security.noEvents','No security events recorded yet.') (L94-97), compact (L98), pagination={{defaultPageSize:50}} (L99), and tableId='admin:security-events' (L90, used as the native testID). Closing braces (L102-105) reproduced.

Inlined native Badge: the web DOM <span> pill (rounded-full, gap-1, font-medium, variant bg/text classes, size sm = px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs) -> a rounded-full View with a tinted surface + border and a caption AppText in the variant colour. Only the three variants this table uses are implemented: success -> successSurface/successBorder/success, danger -> dangerSurface/dangerBorder/danger, neutral -> surfaceRaised/border/textSecondary (the dark-theme analogue of the web light/dark pill pairs). alignSelf:'flex-start' keeps the pill content-width inside the flex cell.

Inlined native TimeStamp: preserves the web value union (string|number|Date|null|undefined), the `instanceof Date` branch, the NaN guard, and the universal '—' placeholder for null/unparseable values. RN has no hover, so the web alternate-format Tooltip is dropped; with no Settings runtime in the parity bundle the 'auto' format resolves to an absolute local format (toLocaleString month/day/hour/minute), while an explicit 'relative' override is still honoured via a small s/m/h/d-ago formatter. The `format` prop signature ('relative'|'absolute'|'auto') is retained.

Inlined native DataTable (subset): the 47 KB web DataTable's resize/reorder/column-visibility/CSV-export/row-selection/layout-persistence are all out of scope for this caller and are dropped; the port implements exactly the props used here — Column<T>{key,header,render,sortable?}, data, keyExtractor, emptyMessage, compact, pagination{defaultPageSize}, plus optional controlled sortKey/sortDir/onSort. Header cells render the column header (uppercased caption); a sortable header is a Pressable calling onSort?.(key) and shows a ▲/▼ indicator only when sortKey===key — exactly mirroring the web (sorting is controlled-only, this caller passes no onSort, so the Time header is a no-op affordance and rows stay in source order). data.length===0 -> a centred emptyMessage; pagination slices data at the page size (50) and shows a Prev/Next pager only when totalPages>1, with the page reset to 1 on row-count change (web `useEffect(()=>setPage(1),[data.length])`). compact -> tighter row vertical padding (web compact density). Each row is a flex row of equal cells (web overflow-x table -> wrapping flex cells; documented native tradeoff).

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (Pressable/StyleSheet/View + StyleProp/TextStyle types), the already-ported native Skeleton/FadeIn, the shared apps/native AppText + GlassPanel, theme tokens (colors/spacing), and the SecurityEvent type. Verified with `npm run typecheck` (exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (exit 0), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (28 suites / 176 tests pass, incl. the added __tests__/EventHistoryTable.test.tsx covering the loading Skeleton, the empty message, a locked+sentry-on row -> Locked/On/Closed/All Closed, an unlocked+sentry-off+open-window row -> Unlocked/Off/1 Open/Venting, the five column headers, and the >1-page Prev/Next pager).
